decisions.rationale: 'bipolar disorder' names a single disease concept used as the object of 'linkage of', so it is not a modifier. It is treated as one specific disease, consistent with how the same condition is handled elsewhere in the abstract.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease mentions); Examples 12 and 14

decisions.rationale: 'bipolar affective disorder' is the full name of a single specific disease, with BPAD as its abbreviation. The long form is annotated as its own mention, using the minimum necessary span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 and 5; Annotation rule 6 (synonymous and abbreviation mentions)

decisions.rationale: 'BPAD' is the abbreviation defined as 'bipolar affective disorder' in parentheses. Per the abbreviation rule it is a separate mention of the same specific disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 (Annotate all synonymous mentions, abbreviation definitions)

decisions.rationale: In 'the BPAD phenotype', BPAD is a disease name that modifies the noun 'phenotype', so it is annotated as a Modifier rather than a standalone disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 (Disease mentions used as Modifiers for other concepts)

decisions.rationale: 'bipolar and recurrent unipolar' is a contiguous string referring to two separate disease mentions (bipolar disorder and recurrent unipolar disorder), so it is annotated as one Composite Mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 2 (Contiguous text strings referring to two or more disease mentions); Examples 7 and 17

decisions.rationale: 'RUP' is the abbreviation defined as 'recurrent unipolar' in parentheses. It refers to one specific disease and is annotated as a separate mention from the long form.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 (Abbreviation definitions annotated as separate mentions)

decisions.rationale: 'bipolar and RUP' is a contiguous string referring to two separate diseases (bipolar disorder and recurrent unipolar disorder), so it is annotated as a Composite Mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 2 (Contiguous text strings referring to two or more disease mentions)

decisions.rationale: In 'linkage of BPAD to chromosome 18', BPAD is the disease itself, the object of 'linkage of', and not a modifier of a noun. It is a repeated mention of the same specific disease, and duplicate mentions are annotated.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease mentions) and 4 (Annotate duplicate mentions)
